comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and AMD disclose strategic initiatives involving external manufacturing partners or acquisitions to reshape their operational dynamics, though the specific actions differ. Intel explicitly states its internal foundry model is designed to drive transparency and efficiency by reshaping operational dynamics, whereas AMD focuses on its acquisition strategy regarding ZT Systems' manufacturing business as part of a plan to seek a strategic partner. While both address manufacturing strategy and operational structure, Intel emphasizes an internal model for cost/efficiency control, while AMD highlights an acquisition-driven approach to its manufacturing footprint.
